message:
Issue #408 Integration Complete. All dead code has been integrated:

1. F2 Fixed: _get_user_input_schema() is now called in create_masters() (line 283)
2. F3 Fixed: validate() now receives user_input_schema parameter (line 388)
3. F4 Fixed: _build_multi_dependency_template() now receives user_input_schema parameter (line 563)

Integration points verified via grep:
- Line 283: user_input_schema = self._get_user_input_schema(sorted_tasks, interfaces)
- Line 370: user_input_schema=user_input_schema (passed to _build_body_template)
- Line 388: user_input_schema=user_input_schema (passed to validate)
- Line 563: user_input_schema=user_input_schema (passed to _build_multi_dependency_template)

All 49 related tests pass. Coverage for body_template_validator.py is 98.4%.

Note: 4 MyPy errors are pre-existing (related to 'Returning Any from function' issues), not introduced by this integration.

Note: 12 pre-existing test failures in tests/unit/test_job_generator_v2/test_master_manager.py and tests/unit/test_master_creation_node.py are NOT caused by Issue #408 changes - they were failing before this integration due to outdated test expectations (expect {{job.body}} but code uses {{job.body.user_input}}).
